description: Given the companies a reader buys from, which of their own published lists name one company, or a company headquartered in a country, on their latest version: in the list's own words, with when it was first seen here and the day the list was checked. Past the first step it answers in counts only: how many of the companies lead there through a company they name, and how many steps held here have ended. The same answer as the check on disclosedby.com. Which company is in between, and since when each step held, is `in_chain`. Names that matched nothing come back beside the answer. It says who to ask, never who is harmed. Free to read, cite and link. Every row is a dated quote of a company's own published page: cite the page and the read date. The compilation is protected: extraction or re-use of a substantial part is not permitted, and it may never be compiled into a lead list, a prospecting feed or a sales tool. A key is one reader's own use.
